about: Every record that changed when the orchestrator's rulings of 2026-11-07 16:19 were applied: 1. 'A statewide contest for a commission seat that elects one seat, by the source's own vote-for or seat count, is a "statewide officer". Where it elects more than one, it keeps the board type. Where the source does not show the count, hold it as a board and do not infer the count.' 2. 'A supreme court or appellate seat elected statewide in a one-seat contest is typed "statewide judge". Retentions stay retentions, and the other judges keep their type.' 3. 'MT's Clerk of the Supreme Court is a statewide officer.' 4. 'NM's PEC members are elected by district, so find the district or hold them.' 5. 'IL 2018's two stray lines: identify them from the State Board's results and fix or hold them, with the reason.' Reasons: 'a race's class is set by what the contest elects'; 'a statewide judicial race is not like a county bench, and the class decides the pool'. Against a85f2d6, whose data files are main's after #87 (afbb7bd). pipeline/local_medsl.py office_type_in, mark_whole_state and known_contests; pipeline/local_ncsbe.py type_of; pipeline/intake/nm_sos.py. Codes: 'T' typed anew, its type before beside it; 'L' p no longer computed (the two held Illinois lines, and 19 judges whose like-race class fell below 100 earlier like races when the statewide seats left it, or whose new class has 8); 'R' p not computed before or after, the count or class its reason names changed; 'I' the record's id changed (New Mexico's five PEC contests now carry their districts); 'Q' a note's words changed. No p value moved and none became computed. Records whose p block changed only in its commit stamp (402) are not listed. data/local/REPORT.md section 25. Written by worker D3 at 2026-11-07 16:43 UTC.
